name: Fail-Closed Efficiency Reporting
hypothesis: If current-run rows are missing, explicit fail-closed output will eliminate misleading zero-delta reports and speed data-pipeline fixes.
change: When current-run rows are empty, output `insufficient_current_run_data`, render deltas as `N/A`, and skip comparative efficiency narrative.
measurement: Count of retro reports with empty current rows that still show numeric deltas (target: 0).
risk: More retros may surface as 'insufficient data' until upstream logging gaps are fixed.
